home.philosophy_title: Wholeness is not something you acquire. It is something you remember.
home.philosophy_text_1: Modern living traps tension in subtle muscular armor. At Nirvana, we treat massage not as a quick mechanical fix, but as a deliberate transition from vigilance into deep physiological peace.
home.philosophy_text_2: Through mindful pacing, calibrated pressure, and therapeutic presence, each session gently guides your nervous system back to its natural equilibrium.
home.featured_subtitle: Each treatment is tailored to your body's present state.
home.therapist_preview_text: Every session at Nirvana is personally conducted by Alina Heorhiieva, physiotherapy and massage specialist with over 7 years of clinical experience.

about.title: Philosophy & Journey
about.subtitle: The path from tension to tranquility unfolds in three conscious phases.
about.step1_desc: Arriving into the present moment. Quieting sensory overload, softening breathing patterns, and allowing the nervous system to feel safe enough to rest.
about.step2_desc: Targeted myofascial release, rhythmic strokes, and warm compresses that melt chronic holding patterns stored deep within connective tissues.
about.step3_desc: Integrating the physical release into mental calm. You leave grounded, spacious, and realigned with your innate vitality.
about.therapist_credentials: Physiotherapist • Massage Specialist • Spa & Rehabilitation Practitioner
about.therapist_bio_1: Alina Heorhiieva is a physiotherapy and massage specialist with over 7 years of practical experience in rehabilitation, injury prevention, and therapeutic procedures. Skilled in developing individualized recovery and fitness programs for clients of all ages.
about.therapist_bio_2: Holding a university degree in Physiotherapy and a medical degree in Nursing, Alina completed an advanced academic exchange program in Hualien City, Taiwan. She unites rigorous clinical knowledge with intuitive oriental bodywork techniques.
about.therapist_travel_note: In addition to regular appointments at her Wrocław studio (ul. Przedmiejska 2/02), Alina accepts selective private and travel sessions across Poland and internationally.

services.title: Treatment Menu
services.subtitle: Harmonious bodywork tailored for health maintenance, athletic recovery, and deep relaxation.
services.custom_note: All sessions include organic cold-pressed jojoba oil, botanical aromatherapy, and post-treatment herbal tea integration.
services.profilaktyczny_short: Focused on maintaining optimal health, relieving muscular tension, and preventing injury.
services.profilaktyczny_full: Preventive massage is focused on maintaining health, reducing muscle tension, and preventing pain. It enhances circulation, promotes overall well-being, and protects the body against everyday physical overload.
services.limfatyczny_short: Gentle technique designed to stimulate lymph flow, reduce swelling, and eliminate excess fluids.
services.limfatyczny_full: Manual lymphatic drainage is a gentle technique designed to improve lymph flow, reduce swelling, and eliminate excess fluids. It accelerates recovery, enhances skin condition, and relieves heavy sensations throughout the body.
services.stretchingowy_short: A harmonious blend of deep bodywork and assisted stretching to boost flexibility and joint mobility.
services.stretchingowy_full: Stretching massage combines bodywork and gentle assisted stretching to enhance flexibility, reduce muscle tension, and increase joint range of motion. Restores bodily ease and fluid movement.
services.sportowy_short: Effective method for muscle regeneration, mobility enhancement, and injury prevention.
services.sportowy_full: Sports massage is an intensive technique focused on preparing muscles for physical exertion and accelerating post-workout recovery. Reduces injury risk, alleviates soreness, and boosts physical performance. Ideal for athletes and active individuals 💪
services.antystresowy_short: A soothing, gentle therapy to dissolve nervous tension, stress, and chronic fatigue.
services.antystresowy_full: Anti-stress massage is a gentle, soothing therapy designed to dissolve nervous tension, reduce stress, and eliminate mental fatigue. Restores inner harmony, promotes restorative sleep, and uplifts overall well-being.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Protection Policy (GDPR)
privacy.intro: At Nirvana Massage Studio, we treat your personal privacy with the same conscious respect we bring to our bodywork. As a studio operating in Poland (European Union), we strictly adhere to Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR).
privacy.s1_text: The controller of your personal data is Nirvana Massage Studio (Alina Heorhiieva), ul. Przedmiejska 2/02, 54-201 Wrocław, Poland. Email: privacy@nirvanamassage.pl.
privacy.s2_text: We collect: (a) Identification & contact details (First name, surname, email, phone) for fulfilling your booking contract; (b) Location information if you request a private travel session; (c) Special-category health information (injuries, allergies, pressure preferences) strictly upon your explicit, separate consent for treatment safety.
privacy.s3_text:
• Booking & Fulfillment: Article 6(1)(b) GDPR (Performance of a contract).
• Health & Contraindication Data: Article 9(2)(a) GDPR (Explicit consent).
• Cookie Consent: Article 6(1)(a) GDPR.
privacy.s4_text: Accounting records are retained per statutory Polish tax requirements. Sensitive health intake forms are retained only for the duration of active treatment and deleted upon request.
privacy.s5_text: You have the right to access, rectify, or erase your data, restrict processing, and withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing prior to withdrawal.
